utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'm ready to collect appliances. Just tell me which neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo! Let's start with the Johnson's old fridge—they mentioned it's been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I'll swing by this afternoon to pick it up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive—I think it was about fixing old electronics? Jules offered to hand out flyers, but I still haven't printed them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's perfect timing, Noah! I can help print the flyers at home—just send me the file and I'll have them ready by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that'd be amazing, Rosa—I'll dig up the file tonight. I think it's on my laptop somewhere... probably.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I keep checking too, but nothing yet. With my youngest's early dance practice, I'm really hoping they give us a heads-up before they start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's Saturday from 10am to 4pm. Does that work with your schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that works perfectly! I can drop the kids off at school and still make it back in time to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, I think Cleo mentioned the repair drive is this Saturday, 10 to 4. Did you want to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I sure do! I've got that old chair that's been wobbling for ages—hope the volunteers can work some magic.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh perfect, I have a wobbly chair too! Maybe we can bring them together—do you know if they'll have the right clamps for that?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Gus, did you happen to see if that repair truck finally moved from Johnson's to the corner lot? I was going to check myself.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven't checked lately, but I think it was supposed to be moved to the lot by the repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, I'm going to head over to the corner lot and see for myself. That truck can't be left blocking the drive any longer.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, are you involved in the repair drive? I heard they're collecting old furniture.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it's this Saturday at the community center, but I thought they were collecting bikes and appliances. Maybe furniture too? I'm not totally sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, Vik mentioned hauling some old furniture from Mrs. Chen's place—maybe I'll swing by and see what else needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sam! You're coming to the repair drive Saturday, right? I think it's at the community center—I should probably write that down somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'll be there! I've been helping put up flyers and sort out the schedule, so I'm definitely in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, great! I knew you were the organized type—maybe you can remind me where I put that rusty wrench I was talking about?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Did you say the drive's coming to our street this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that's right! We'll be all along Elm Street starting at 9am—I've got you down as a potential helper already!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I can patch up some fence posts if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're collecting tools and appliances to fix up for folks in need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh yeah, I'm the one organizing it! We're collecting at the old garage—tools, spare parts, anything fixable.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No way, that's awesome! I've got an old toaster I've been meaning to drop off—what time are you guys open on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just making sure everyone knows—Saturday, 9 AM, community center for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't heard a thing about it from anyone official.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it’s definitely happening! I’ve been telling everyone—Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. I even reminded Oren twice so he wouldn’t show up on Sunday!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I've been checking every morning, but still nothing. Honestly, I think they forgot to post the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh dear, that's worrying. We really need that schedule to avoid clashing with the block party. Should we reach out to the organizers directly?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I suppose we could try calling the community center, though I'm not sure who's in charge of the notices.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I noticed a flyer posted on the community board near the entrance. It said they'd be doing repairs on our block around 2 PM tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 2 PM tomorrow? I'll try to clear my morning schedule then, hope I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll try to be there too, though I might be running a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, you won't believe it—I just offered to help Vik haul stuff from Mrs. Chen's place for the repair drive. Got my truck ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, we’ll need the extra hands. You got the time straight—Saturday 10 to 4?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Saturday works for me—I've got the whole day free, so I'll be there bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're still looking for folks to help with transport.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, this weekend? I haven't seen the details yet. Do you know what times they're planning? I've got to juggle school drop-offs and dance practice.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's from 9 to 3 on Saturday, so that should work around your schedule! And they're meeting at the community center parking lot if you want to lend a hand with moving things.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard from someone that the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center—they're fixing up old bikes and appliances and need volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, this Saturday? I thought I had more time—did someone already put up my flyers?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure about the flyers, but I know Opal was just checking on that repair truck down the street.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I remember seeing a notice tacked to the bulletin board by the mailboxes. It said they'd be on our street around 2 PM tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's right, 2 PM tomorrow—I've been telling everyone to be ready, we're meeting at the community center first at 9 AM to sort out the furniture before the truck comes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, 9 AM? That's early, but I'll be there to help with the furniture.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rey, do you know when the block party is? I want to make sure the repair drive doesn't clash with it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hmm, I'm not sure about the block party, but I think the repair drive is tomorrow afternoon. I haven't seen a flyer for either, though.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Tomorrow afternoon? That sounds awfully rushed—I was hoping we'd have enough time to gather tools and supplies first. Are you sure about that date?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Leo, are you planning to join the repair drive on Saturday? I want to make sure we have enough people to help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Already signed up. Tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'm glad you're on board. Do you know if there are any specific tools or materials we're still short on?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Jules, I checked my calendar and the repair drive's on Saturday morning—doesn't clash with any other events I know of.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, that’s great news. I’ll make sure the coffee shop regulars know it’s this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Awesome, thanks for spreading the word Jules. Let me know if y'all need me to pick up any donated tools beforehand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll let you know soon as I see anything, Faye. I walk past the board every morning anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Uli, if you're heading past the board anyway, I can give you some flyers to put up too—save me a trip.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Sam, I can do that. Just give me the stack and I'll tack them up when I check the board tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great to hear from you both! Sam, I have the flyers right here—you can grab them from my porch anytime. And Rosa, your enthusiasm really lifts this whole effort!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've got my shed ready for inventory. If we're set on Saturday at 9, I'd like to check our tools beforehand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Eli—Saturday at 9 works great. I'll swing by your shed later today to help sort through everything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, still trying to figure out the details on that repair drive—Saturday at the community center, right? I think I've got an old drill somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Saturday at the community center, 10 AM sharp. By the way, have you seen if that repair truck moved from Johnson's yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nah, I haven't seen it. Is it blocking the street again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! I'm so glad to see you—I'm organizing a neighborhood repair drive this weekend and was hoping you could help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Are you sure that's a real thing, or did someone make that up? I haven't heard anything about it until now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, it's absolutely real! I've been coordinating it for a few weeks now—we're fixing small appliances and electronics to help neighbors save money and reduce waste.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Cleo! The repair drive—was that this Saturday? I wrote it down but I can't find my notes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Oren, it's this Saturday from 9 to 3 at the old garage. We'd love any tools or spare parts you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, right! I'll dig through my shed tonight—there's bound to be a rusty something in there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
